ZF MENU STUDIO V14.1 · 30 BUILT-IN MENU DESIGNS

1. Choose from 30 photographic menu designs + 70 other layouts

Choose one of the 30 menu designs without FZ MENU. Add your own editable restaurant name, headings, dishes and prices on top. The small printed taglines in these backgrounds are part of the picture.

2. Find real photographs

Search Wikimedia Commons for real, individually selectable photos. Results are filtered to public-domain or CC0 images when license metadata is available. Web access is needed. Most photos have backgrounds; crop and transparency controls work, but automatic background removal is not included.
Search to load real photos.

3. Bring your own design

Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP menu from another designer. It becomes a background. You can add and edit new text, prices and graphics on top. Existing writing in a flat picture cannot be individually edited.

4. Edit selected element

Select anything on the menu to edit it. All text, graphics and uploaded images can be moved, resized, duplicated or deleted.
